Bx.bar_b_note: A warm, appealing elderly villager in natural green/brown with a clean hair-and-beard silhouette that sits beside Palworld's NPCs at a similar finish; only the neutral backdrop keeps it from showing world light.

Aj.bar_b_note: The near-black purple bird sinks into the dark backdrop, so its face and eyes are lost at small size and it lacks the high-contrast read of Palworld creatures.

Ul.bar_b_note: A naturalistic boar with readable fur and tusks that matches the owner's style bar and would sit beside a Palworld field creature, though it only roughly matches the trainer's height.

Jp.bar_b_note: The Stormcapra model matches the owner's bar (white fleece, dark curled horns, blue accent) and reads at Palworld finish; the faint poses are the weak point.

Ja.bar_b_note: A bright blue water lizard with a clear silhouette, but the faint poses break (A twists up vertically, B's shadow sits detached below it) and the flat grey stage has no atmosphere.

Me.bar_b_note: Identical in look to Aj: a near-black body against a dark stage, with no readable face or value separation at small size.

Es.bar_b_note: The bird renders as a near-monochrome, chrome-white burst of feather spikes instead of the owner bar's slate-and-tan Galecrest, so it reads as a material error rather than a finished creature.

Tw.bar_b_note: B's braced timber frame, plank cap and stone footing now read as built, but the lone flat-infill panel, untextured placeholder boulder and evenly spaced tree row keep the scene well short of Palworld's base-building finish and Valheim's light.

Rp.bar_b_note: Tanglevolt matches the owner's bar (dark violet fur, lightning veining, pale muzzle) with a strong side silhouette, and its faint roll reads without a label.

top_changes.change: Tw: give the homestead wall real thickness and a textured wattle or plank infill in the village kit's timber palette, then blend its stone footing into the grass; also replace or texture the flat grey placeholder boulder beside it.

Creature materials and value: lift Duskhush's (Aj/Me) mid-values and give it a lit face and eyes so it separates from the dark stage, and regrade Galecrest (Es) from chrome-white to the owner bar's slate/tan feathers with lower specular and no bright edge rim.

Re-author the faint clips that break the read: Ja A's vertical twist, Ja B's raised body with detached shadow, Jp's detached-looking horn (A) and mid-air roll (B), and Ul B's pale spike toward the trainer.
